claim_scope: harness development and token-parity calibration only; these exposed cases are not holdout and cannot support a comparative claim
research_question: Does an auditable multi-turn pragmatic loop improve felt understanding and correction quality over direct current-dialogue generation under the same base model and Uruha expression contract?

conditions.baseline: same base model, current dialogue, and public-evidence-grounded Uruha expression contract; no structured cross-turn hypothesis/prediction/verification/calibration state
conditions.system: same base model, dialogue, and Uruha expression contract plus V2.13 cross-turn pragmatic/other/self/relationship/persona/action/learning state packet

persona_evidence_boundary.positioning: public-evidence-grounded Uruha persona model; never the real person
persona_evidence_boundary.allowed: publicly observable language, values, style, and interaction tendencies with provenance
persona_evidence_boundary.forbidden: invented childhood, private memories, private relationships, or unobserved mental states

blind_rating.scale: 1-5 per dimension plus forced A/B/tie preference

proxy_evidence_boundary: Keyword and trace proxies are harness checks only; they are not evidence of human felt-understanding preference.
